title: Rippers — Deeper Bonds
description: The campaign's Deeper Bonds system (Aaron Jolliffe playtest) for Project FU: bond tiers (fleeting/solid/eternal), 4-section Bond Clocks on solid bonds, a strength ladder, and invoke = +strength retroactive to the roll just made (via FU's check-push). Extends FU bonds without forking. P1: data model + clocks + tiered caps + invoke wiring.

rippers-deeper-bonds.note: P1 BUILT + headless-tested; NOT verified in Foundry; NOT published. Extends FU bonds via flags.rippers-deeper-bonds.bonds (keyed by name + index tiebreak); clock-strength pushed into bond.bonus so FU strength getter + Penny Knight keep working. Invoke piggybacks FU check-push. FU internals feature-detected + fail-soft; projectfu pinned 4.16.0/4.16.2. See COVERAGE.md for the verify checklist + owed items.
